title: Refined Inner Twists and Kaletha Framework
body_html:
Refined Inner Twists and Kaletha Framework

This topic node contains the DAG module RF5: extended pure inner twists, rigid inner twists, and Kaletha's refinements of inner forms.

This node is visible under the rational-forms topic because Kaletha's refinements belong to the inner-form layer, while its dependencies include Kottwitz structures.
